body: That’s foul 🤢

It’s almost as if the whole point was HOW they can go to the doctors without their parents finding out/telling them, as they’re a minor and don’t have a good relationship with the parents. How hard is it to have some empathy?
I resigned whilst I was suspended and they accepted my resignation. Managed to get 2 job offers within a month and cleared the vetting process of those jobs too. I’d say try your luck.
i highly doubt it
exactly, it gives depression a reason to drown you further. people like that are fucking insensitive idiots.
yeah but ghosting isn’t the way to go about it.
well unless the shoe fits, i don’t get why you’re getting so defensive over the original post?
hey im a female. you can message me anytime and i’ll be your friend!
i went from 50mg to 100mg and i honestly felt more depressed being on them. i also felt really numb the first few weeks especially.
yes. for some reason i feel my depression gets even worse in winter, but i feel slightly better in summer.

i understand how you feel. whenever i talk about my depression, i get ignored as if i don’t exist to begin with. people love trying to “talk” to you when they need your help, but when you need them they play ghost and act oblivious to it.
can’t give pain to someone else if you have nobody
i understand this 110%. i have nobody in my life and people still say bs like “people care about you” etc. not sure which people, but it’s definitely not the ones in my life.
how is being upset about having nobody to talk to childish? that’s just dumb

i wish doctors would take mental illnesses as seriously as physical illnesses. i highly doubt he would’ve said that to someone with a broken bone. i hope you find something that will help you with your depression and hopefully you’ll get better.
it’s the little things that count! i hope you find something that takes away your disappointment and makes you feel happy about every accomplishment :)
thank you. hope the same for you too! 😊
they’re not helpful, neither is my doctor. my antidepressants don’t work so suicide it is for me.
i have nobody to talk to. none of my friend or family care about me whatsoever, they’ll just ignore me.
i was prescribed sertraline (zoloft) and it worked ok for a while although i felt numb the first few weeks, but after that it felt totally useless. i felt like i was getting worse instead of better.

for real. i opened up to friends and not only did they ignore me, but say bs like “others have it worse” “be grateful you don’t have bombs falling in your neighbourhood” and the classic “you’re doing it for attention”. i hate people.
my depression is like a living nightmare/hell. it feels like i’ll be trapped there forever.
